decisions.statement: A seat working in a terminal in this window has that terminal brought forward.
A seat with no terminal here has its transcript opened instead.
A column already remembered for the seat is taken where that column is open.
An ancestor's column is taken where no column is remembered for the seat.
The nearest ancestor with a terminal is the ancestor whose column is taken.
The lowest open column is taken where neither column is to be had.
Which column was chosen and why is said in the output.
A lookup with no seat finds no terminal for any seat.
Nothing here changes the work a seat is doing.

definition: what a click on a seat brings up, and the column it comes up in
